title: Resolution declaring October 18 Pell's Point Patriots Day
summary: This resolution would designate October 18 each year as Pell's Point Patriots Day in New York City. It commemorates American soldiers who fought British forces at the 1776 Battle of Pell's Point in what is now the Bronx's Pelham Bay Park. The resolution states the battle, though not a decisive victory, boosted American morale and delayed British advancement during the Revolutionary War.
